text: A deterministic two-qubit CNOT gate can be implemented directly with linear optics alone, using only beam splitters and phase shifters and no measurement.
explanation: False. Because photons do not interact, no linear-optical circuit gives a deterministic two-qubit gate, the 'no-interaction problem.' Entangling gates require measurement-induced nonlinearity (KLM), which makes them probabilistic (for example the NS gate at 1/4).
